headline: OEM gigacasting paths diverge; Xiaomi SU7 earns EPD certification

summary.text: VW halted its German gigacasting plant project while Toyota continues mass production in Shanghai, so OEM insourcing is uneven and Lindner's volume planning should not assume one path.
Drone photos hint at giga presses at Tesla's Optimus factory site, a sign of OEM insourcing that could affect Lindner's structural part business with Tesla.
A foundry-planet market overview compares gigacasting and megacasting; it is useful context on how much mid-size structural volume is at risk from insourcing.
Xiaomi's SU7 received an EPD certification, signalling that OEMs may increasingly demand product carbon data from aluminium casting suppliers, which touches Lindner's PCF and CBAM exposure.

actions.text: Sales lead: review Tesla and VW programme volumes against the insourcing signals and flag any at-risk parts for the next planning meeting.
Sustainability/quality lead: check whether Lindner can deliver part-level carbon footprint (PCF) data on request, and list gaps before customers ask.
Business development: read the foundry-planet overview and note where mid-size integrated castings could be offered as an alternative to full gigacasting.
